description: Machine-readable map from proposal design decisions to the code and tests that satisfy them. Checked by the project's conformance checker. Statuses: conformant (code+tests match the spec), partial (known gaps listed), unimplemented (accepted design, no code yet), n-a (process/meta proposal with no code surface). Rules: conformant requires tests; partial requires gaps; update in the same commit as the code that changes conformance.
